purpose: Consolidate maintained code by job and place every machine learning implementation in one file.

tests.shared_memory_support: Test suite ran with operating-system shared-memory support; sandbox-only baseline had environmental worker/subprocess failures.

checkpoint_verification.comparison: exact equality including NaNs, masks and state keys

notebook_verification.execution: plain Python with display-only fallback; no Jupyter kernel installed

compatibility.imports: Use wildfire, wildfire.models, wildfire.heat and other new job modules; old package directories are removed.
compatibility.saved_local_paths: Resolved at read time without rewriting records.
compatibility.missing_older_data_roots: Current inputs are accepted only after all saved source hashes and sizes match.
compatibility.frozen_experiment_resume: Original protocols retain original paths and source hashes; changed code is still rejected. Use saved source snapshots for original-source resumption.
compatibility.tutorial_default_checkpoint: A retained 5x5 supported candidate from the completed 20261010_categorical_balanced_benchmark replaces an already-missing older tutorial default. Historical outputs retain their original identifiers.

scope: Regression and organization verification; no full model retraining or new scientific/operational validation.
